maxRps.rationale: Prose gives no explicit admission ceiling, so use a large typical LB/API gateway limit well above current 10k rps load.

instances.rationale: Stated directly: 20 instances behind the load balancer.

concurrencyPerInstance.rationale: Not stated; typical concurrency for a stateless API instance handling I/O-bound redirect/create requests.

serviceTimeMs.rationale: Not stated; typical CPU/IO time for a lightweight redirect/create handler excluding downstream cache/db wait.

hitRate.rationale: Prose says most traffic is for recently shortened links so cache should absorb a good chunk; no exact figure given, so use a high but not extreme hit rate typical of such workloads.

hitLatencyMs.rationale: Typical round-trip latency for a client to a remote in-memory Redis cache.

cpuTimeMs.rationale: Typical Redis server-side processing time for a single GET, orders of magnitude below round-trip latency.

keyspaceHotSet.rationale: Not stated; inferred as moderate since recently shortened links form the hot set for a high-traffic shortener.

connectionPoolSize.rationale: Stated directly: connection pool capped at 100.

queryTimeMs.rationale: Not stated; typical simple indexed lookup/insert time for Postgres.

writeRatio.rationale: Prose says creating links happens rarely compared to redirects, so writes are a small fraction of total DB traffic.

readReplicas.rationale: Stated directly: no read replicas are run.

replicaApplyRate.rationale: No replicas exist so sustained replica apply capacity is zero.
